test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'HAPPY’ is written as 'JBRQA' and 'MACRO' is written as 'OBESQ'. How will 'MATES' be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

'HAPPY’ is written as 'JBRQA'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3e602ab5efa4a0f5ad862edfd6bed3229890cfdeb2fc0d53062014cc9eb2e79.png] 

'MACRO' is written as 'OBESQ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f25457175161892b4d63bba5308dd79738920e4640bf0e60914b07a87dca7b6.png] 

Similarly, 'MATES' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4615505bc1aa2f472c096c1f9ceff90f143097a32df5749a83eb4f8872b226a.png] 

Hence,** 'option 1' **is the correct answer.
